sentences.text: 02.02.2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

2. The petitioner is aggrieved that the application dated 05.07.2023 filed by the petitioner before the Members/Secretary, DLSA, Dhubri, Assam has not been taken up and appropriate orders have been passed.
The petitioner is a victim of an offence under Sections 365/376 of IPC, R/W Section 6 of POCSO Act in connection with Gouripur PS Case No. 74/2022.

3. Mr. N. Das, learned Government Advocate for the State respondents and Ms. R.S. Choudhury,
learned Standing Counsel, ASLSA for the respondent No.2 will obtain instructions on the application filed by the petitioner before the DLSA, Dhubri.

4. Let these instructions be placed before the Court on 09.02.2026.
5.
Although notices are not issued, extra copies be furnished to the respondent counsels within a period of two working days.
